notes: Added missing schema, UI rendering, and edge-case handling stories to complete explainability layer coverage.

change_log.note: Add UI consumption of explainability layer

stories.title: Explainability Schema Definition
stories.description: Define a standardized explainability schema (source, meaning, limitations, confidence optional) to be used across provider and clinical trial signals, ensuring compatibility with facade responses and tool outputs.

stories.title: Explainability Builder Edge Case Handling
stories.description: Enhance explainability builder logic to gracefully handle missing, null, or conflicting signal data by populating fallback explanations and clearly communicating limitations to the user.

stories.title: Frontend Rendering of Explainability Metadata
stories.description: Update MessageBubble and chat rendering logic to display explainability metadata (source, meaning, limitations) in a clear, user-friendly format without overwhelming the conversational experience.
